known_limitations: The historical executable used a foreign C++/GGML/Vulkan/CMake implementation and is not a HAR runtime dependency.
The model artifact is excluded; its identity hash and byte counts are retained only as provenance.
The raw ubatch=4096 file is malformed because GDB text was appended after the W1536 object.
The ubatch=4096 W2048 attempt aborted during Vulkan queue submission and has no valid throughput value.
The receipt does not include a per-output numerical known-answer comparison or per-cell clock telemetry.
W in this receipt is n_prompt/prefill rows, not shader workgroup width and not generation tokens/s.
W4096 has predictions and preregistration evidence only; no authoritative measurement was found.
